proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4701 carman explicitly includes Hindi camṛā, Gujarati cāmḍī and Lahnda/Punjabi camṛā skin/leather. The c/ts forms fit those extensions; regional s forms need their own affricate/fricative correspondence evidence. Exact survey form tsamḍi is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
